issues.description: The script overrides the global WebSocket constructor to modify the connection URL by appending custom query parameters. This could potentially affect all WebSocket connections on the page.
issues.recommendation: Limit WebSocket override scope if possible; ensure no sensitive data is appended or intercepted.

summary: The script modifies the WebSocket constructor to change the connection URL for arras.io, adding custom parameters. It does not transmit user data, collect privacy-sensitive information, or use dangerous APIs. There is no code obfuscation or DOM XSS risk. The only concern is the global WebSocket override, which is a medium risk if other scripts rely on standard WebSocket behavior. Overall, the script is safe with minor caution.
